footprint-area.definition: Horizontal area enclosed by footprint exterior minus holes.

polygon-area.description: Horizontal area enclosed by footprint exterior minus holes.

footprint-area.limitations: Roof overhangs, courtyards and overlapping parts require an explicit convention.

building-height.definition: Vertical separation of the named base and top levels.
building-height.basis: base datum to stated roof or massing top

base-to-top.description: Vertical separation of the named base and top levels.

building-height.alternatives: Eaves, ridge, median roof or storey-derived estimate.
building-height.limitations: Retain datum and roof convention. Modelled height has no measured status.
building-height.validationExample: Model datum 0 m and top 12 m gives 12 m.

building-depth.definition: Cross-axis distance defined by the named method.

short-side-of-named-axis-envelope.description: Cross-axis distance defined by the named method.

building-depth.alternatives: Local façade-to-façade transects; minimum rectangle minor side.
building-depth.limitations: Envelope short side can differ from wing or core depth in an L-shaped building.
building-depth.validationExample: A 15 m × 10 m rectangle with long axis east–west has 10 m depth.

building-length.definition: Along-axis span of projected footprint coordinates.

named-axis-span.description: Along-axis span of projected footprint coordinates.

building-length.alternatives: Diameter/longest axis; minimum oriented rectangle major side; façade length.
building-length.limitations: Maximum pair distance and along-axis extent are different methods.
building-length.validationExample: The same rectangle spans 15 m along the east–west axis.

building-orientation.definition: Axis bearing clockwise from the declared north reference, modulo 180°.
building-orientation.basis: axial azimuth of explicit reference axis

axial-bearing-from-north.description: Axis bearing clockwise from the declared north reference, modulo 180°.

building-orientation.alternatives: Dominant façade direction; oriented rectangle; deviation from cardinal orientation.
building-orientation.limitations: A square has no unique major axis. Grid and true north differ.

study-area.definition: Horizontal area inside the named study boundary, minus holes.

polygon-area.description: Horizontal area inside the named study boundary, minus holes.

study-area.alternatives: Plot, block, administrative, buffered or tessellation boundary.
study-area.limitations: Coverage and FAR comparisons depend on this boundary and on clipping.
study-area.validationExample: A 40 m × 32 m block has 1,280 m².

building-coverage.definition: Union area of plan footprints inside the study boundary divided by study area.

clipped-union-over-study-area.description: Union area of plan footprints inside the study boundary divided by study area.

building-coverage.alternatives: Sum clipped footprints only when interiors are disjoint.
building-coverage.limitations: Count overlap once. Coverage excludes exterior roof projection under the wall-footprint convention.

floor-area.definition: Sum the included horizontal floor plates under a named area basis.
floor-area.basis: declared floor-area inclusion and measurement basis
floor-area.geometry: Floor polygons or model footprint and storeys

sum-included-floor-plates.description: Sum the included horizontal floor plates under a named area basis.

identical-footprint-times-storeys.description: Multiply footprint area by the number of identical modelled storeys.

floor-area.alternatives: Repeated identical footprint × storeys; audited source value under declared basis.
floor-area.limitations: Modelled floor area differs from statutory kerrosala, useful area and huoneistoala.
floor-area.validationExample: 896 m² repeated over four identical storeys gives 3,584 m².

floor-area-ratio.definition: Included floor area divided by the explicitly bounded study area.

floor-area-over-study-area.description: Included floor area divided by the explicitly bounded study area.

floor-area-ratio.limitations: Distinguish denominator scopes and numerator inclusion rules.

courtyard-area.definition: Horizontal area of an explicitly delineated courtyard polygon.

explicit-court-area.description: Horizontal area of an explicitly delineated courtyard polygon.

courtyard-area.alternatives: Footprint hole for a closed courtyard; explicit closing line for an open courtyard.
courtyard-area.limitations: A footprint hole may be an atrium or void. Open-court area depends on declared closing edges.
courtyard-area.validationExample: A 24 m × 16 m inner court has 384 m².

courtyard-width.definition: Distance between opposing courtyard boundaries along an explicitly named transect.

selected-transect.description: Distance between opposing courtyard boundaries along an explicitly named transect.

courtyard-width.alternatives: Minimum width or distribution over a documented family of transects.
courtyard-width.limitations: A selected width is not a minimum for irregular courts.
courtyard-width.validationExample: The horizontal transect of a 24 m × 16 m court is 24 m.

spatial-enclosure.definition: Length of court boundary touching building edges divided by total court perimeter.

boundary-contact-fraction.description: Length of court boundary touching building edges divided by total court perimeter.

spatial-enclosure.alternatives: Visual openness from sampled rays; sky-view factor; vertical enclosure index.
spatial-enclosure.limitations: Plan contact says nothing about height, visibility or permeability. A coincident edge is counted once.
spatial-enclosure.validationExample: A 24 m × 16 m court bounded on three sides with 24 m open has enclosure 56 / 80 = 0.7.

street-space-width.definition: Distance between opposite façade references along a named section transect.

selected-facade-transect.description: Distance between opposite façade references along a named section transect.

street-space-width.alternatives: Right-of-way or kerb width; sampled street profile with explicit hit/miss policy.
street-space-width.limitations: Different boundary and sampling methods are not directly comparable.
street-space-width.validationExample: Opposing façades at offsets 0 m and 20 m yield 20 m.

height-to-width-ratio.definition: Mean of two declared facing heights divided by façade-to-façade width at the same transect.

mean-facing-height-over-width.description: Mean of two declared facing heights divided by façade-to-façade width at the same transect.

height-to-width-ratio.alternatives: Separate side ratios; maximum height; sample-wise ratios.
height-to-width-ratio.limitations: Preserve each side height. This is H/W, the reciprocal of W/H shown in the street ratio reference.

canopy-coverage.definition: Union of projected canopy inside the study area divided by area of the study boundary.
canopy-coverage.basis: clipped projected crown union / study area

clipped-canopy-union-over-study-area.description: Union of projected canopy inside the study area divided by area of the study boundary.

canopy-coverage.alternatives: Raster classification or orthophoto crown extraction with declared resolution.
canopy-coverage.limitations: Retain date, classification threshold, overlap, raster resolution and clipping policy.
canopy-coverage.validationExample: 100 m² crown union over 1,000 m² yields 0.1.
